steps: New scripts carry a versioned table declaration; creation and re-edit forms have unique IDs. A saved bound TXT reopens into the table, edits two event edges, previews exact before/after source in three languages at390px, and cancellation leaves editor and author files unchanged.

Modified handwritten source is preserved and cannot be overwritten by the table. Apply changes only the current source draft; reopening uses that unsaved draft and no-op cannot write. Ordinary Save changes only the existing TXT, preserving object identity, registration and behavior bindings.

Real GUI planning, build and Godot run execute initial idle → event attack → one natural completion → looped idle through the exact controller source just edited and saved in the GUI. Separate completion and command panels display actual frozen histories; three languages at390px retain search and have no horizontal overflow.

Separate read-only controls open the frozen animation, clip and subscribing behavior declarations at their exact registered source locations. Runtime execution and source navigation leave all author files unchanged after the deliberate same-file TXT save.

zh-CN.text:

en.text:
Natural animation completionsRead-only records of non-looping animations reaching their end naturally. Stopping, seeking to the end and loop boundaries do not produce completion notifications. History remains across scenes and resets on a new run.
    Handled means the synchronous callback succeeded; it does not confirm that subsequent animation commands executed. Skipped may result from unsubscribing, leaving the scene or a new animation command, and does not mean the subscription is permanently removed.

ja.title: アニメーション自然終了の記録
ja.text:

    処理済みは同期コールバックの成功を表し、その後のアニメーションコマンドの実行完了を保証しません。スキップは購読解除、シーン退出、新しいアニメーションコマンドなどによって発生し、恒久的な購読解除を意味しません。
